one_liner: A one-touch lane-switching runner where every move lands on the beat.
why_this_opportunity: Yandex arcade is saturated with one-touch reaction games (claim-0a01) but carries no rhythm titles in its top 20 (claim-0a04). The control idiom players already know is the one this design needs, so the novelty budget goes entirely into feel rather than into teaching.

platform_set.rationale: Primary audience and the only targeted portal with both rewarded video and a matching category.
Cheap secondary once the build exists; no IAP dependency to unwind.

audience.player_description: Plays in short bursts on a mid-range Android phone, expects to be playing within seconds of the page loading.

monetization.rationale: The fail-and-retry loop creates a genuine rewarded moment — continue the run rather than lose the combo. Interstitials sit between runs, never inside one.

mvp: One track with three difficulty ramps
One-touch lane switching locked to the beat
Combo and score with a personal best
Yandex SDK: init, loading progress, rewarded video, cloud save of best score
out_of_scope: Multiple music tracks — one track proves the mechanic; more is content, not validation
prototype_must_prove: Audio-to-input latency on mid-range mobile web is low enough that beat-matching feels fair rather than arbitrary
A first-time player understands the control without instruction
The fail-and-retry loop produces an unforced desire to retry immediately
A rewarded continue reads as a favour rather than an interruption

success_criteria.label: D1 retention
success_criteria.rationale: Below this, a score-chase arcade title without a metagame has no path to sustained traffic on portal distribution.

success_criteria.label: Median session at or above target
success_criteria.rationale: Shorter than this and at most one interstitial can ever show, which breaks the monetization assumption.

kill_criteria.label: Beat matching feels unfair on mid-range mobile
kill_criteria.rationale: Above roughly 60ms players perceive correct inputs as misses. The entire design rests on the beat feeling authoritative, and no amount of polish recovers a mechanic players believe is cheating.

kill_criteria.label: First-time players do not understand the control
kill_criteria.rationale: The whole positioning argument is that this control idiom is already familiar on Yandex. If it needs teaching, that argument was wrong and the opportunity's premise fails with it.

kill_criteria.label: Players do not retry unprompted
kill_criteria.rationale: Immediate retry is both the retention loop and the rewarded-ad moment. Without it there is no game and no revenue model.
